name: Misa Brigitta Cristelis
original_name: 聖沙・ブリジッタ・クリステレス
source:
Favorite food: Tea (she also likes curry rice and hamburgers)
Hated food: Carrots, green peppers (she can eat them if she tries)
Hobbies: Collecting cute stuff, writing poems
Skills: Singing, writing poems

2nd-year student and  the student council vice-president. Misa thinks of [url=/c3392]Shin[/url] as a rival, and always challenges him despite always ending up in second, falling behind him. She's especially annoyed about losing the election which Shin won by sheer luck.

In battle, Misa uses the lighting element, which is why she has the fastest attack speed in the game. This is compensated by her slow charge speed. However, her power is on par with Lolotte's. While her support is average, despite of it Misa's fast speed and multi-hit extra attacks make her a good relentless combo attacker, but not one to rely on for high damage attacks. Her title is Storm Sagittarius.
